`321-328`: **LGTM — frontend correctly addresses GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26 minimatch ReDoS vulnerability.** All resolutions target the patched floor versions: - `minimatch@^3.x` → `^3.1.3` (v3 floor) - `minimatch@3.0.4` and `@3.0.5` → `^3.1.3` (explicit exact mappings) - `minimatch@^9.0.4` → `^9.0.6` (v9 floor) - `minimatch@^10.1.2` → `^10.2.1` (v10 floor) Lockfile confirms all resolved versions (3.1.5, 9.0.9, 10.2.5) meet or exceed patched floors. Line 321 keeps `postcss` semantically unchanged.

📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This pull request introduces dependency resolution overrides to two `package.json` files. The `dynamic-demo-plugin/package.json` adds a new `resolutions` block that pins multiple `minimatch` version specifiers to unified versions (`^3.1.3` and `^9.0.6`). Similarly, `frontend/package.json` expands its existing `resolutions` block with seven `minimatch` entries mapping to `^3.1.3`, `^9.0.6`, or `^10.2.1`, while retaining the existing `postcss` resolution at `^8.2.13` with minor formatting adjustments. No other package metadata, scripts, or dependencies were modified.
